capabilities: pull a DocBase note's title, tags, draft status, and content into an Obsidian note
push an Obsidian note's content back to update an existing DocBase post
authenticate with a DocBase API token and team domain set in plugin settings
extras: Pushing only works for notes already posted to DocBase and overwrites title, tags, and draft status; handling multiple DocBase teams is not yet implemented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read or update notes stored as posts on a DocBase team site.
summary: Connects Obsidian to DocBase so you can pull a DocBase post into a note and push note updates back to DocBase.
